comment: Player houses (2026-10-15, Phase 6, docs/INTERIORS.md "The Dustline house"). A house is a private first-person interior: "zone" is the instanced interior zone (floor key "interior" with "instance": "owner"), "door" the passage in the city that only its owner may take. "upgrades": what the house agent installs (prices in data/shops, "property"). "mounts": wall slots where the owner hangs items from the cargo (position = the slot centre in metres local to the zone's anchor, yaw = degrees the slot faces into the room, 0 = toward +Z); mounted items stay the owner's and come back with TAKE.
